decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Unnumbered design and access statement, unnumbered flood risk assessment, L(-4)101, L(-4)102, L(-2)101, L(-2)102, L(-2)103, L(-3)101, L(-3)102, L(-1)101, L(-3)302, L(-3)301, L(-2)301, L(-2)303, L(-2)305, received 14/05/2013, L(-4)302, L(-2)302, received 03/07/2013) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Other than that which is shown on the submitted drawings, the additional roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a ground floor rear extension, conversion of ground floor garage to habitable space and erection of opaque privacy screens around the roof at first floor level to be used as a roof terrace
